We need to find a retrosynthetic template that forms sulfonamide (N-S bond) from aromatic amine and phenylsulfonyl chloride. The target molecule SMILES: O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O

We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id. We need to search template catalog with criteria: functional_groups_broken includes "sulfonyl_chloride"? Not sure list. Could use bonds broken: S-Cl bond broken, N-S bond formed. So bonds_broken ["S-Cl"]? Format expects "X-Y" where X and Y are atomic numbers? Example "6-6". So S is atomic number 16, Cl is 17. So bond broken "16-17". Bond formed N-S: N is 7, S 16 => "7-16". Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with those.
